author: marthomahew
name: embedfix
short: Repost social links through proxies that embed properly.
description: When someone posts a Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok or Reddit link, reposts the message under their name with a proxy link that embeds properly in Discord (or replies with the fixed link). The proxy list is editable from Discord.
install_msg: Loaded? It's on by default. See `[p]embedfix list` for the current proxies. Give the bot Manage Messages and Manage Webhooks so it can repost fixed messages.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data.
